jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
About Our Client:

The organization specializes in environmental monitoring and intelligence, providing technologies and services focused on weather, wildfire, and water conditions. Its solutions include sensors, dataloggers, telemetry systems, and advanced analytics that help communities and organizations monitor environmental conditions, manage risk, and make informed decisions.

About the Opportunity:

The Field Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing environmental monitoring equipment and systems. This role combines fieldwork, technical support, data quality management, and customer service to ensure monitoring systems remain reliable and deliver accurate environmental data. The position requires hands-on technical expertise, adaptability, and a willingness to work in challenging outdoor environments and travel as needed.

Responsibilities:

• Monitor, maintain, integrate, install, troubleshoot, and repair environmental monitoring products and systems.
• Provide onsite field support and remote technical assistance to diagnose and resolve system issues.
• Communicate effectively with internal teams and customers to resolve problems and meet project objectives.
• Maintain data integrity through timely, accurate, and consistent data entry and processing.
• Keep project documentation current and accurately reflect project status.
• Follow established standard operating procedures and safety requirements.
• Perform outdoor installation and maintenance activities, including climbing ladders, replacing equipment, and preparing installation sites.
• Train and guide customers on product functionality and proper operation.
• Analyze monitoring data for completeness and accuracy to support system reliability.
• Develop and execute service plans within established timelines to optimize network performance.
• Schedule field jobs, prepare equipment and inventory, and travel to customer sites as required.

Requirements:

• Two-year technical degree or 1–3 years of relevant experience installing mounting hardware, sensors, cables, masts, antennas, satellite dishes, or network equipment.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to resolving technical issues.
• Ability to work under strict deadlines and in challenging environmental conditions.
• Strong attention to detail and interest in meteorological and environmental data.
• Proficiency with hand and machine tools, digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, and electrical diagnostic equipment.
• Experience with construction activities such as concrete work, conduit installation, masonry, trenching, or road construction.
• Knowledge of environmental sensors, dataloggers, DC circuits, and basic circuitry analysis.
• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities when appropriate, and manage time effectively.
• Experience troubleshooting RF systems, electronics, telemetry, and meteorological sensors in challenging environments.
• Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Windows and ERP software; experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce preferred.
• Physical ability to work at heights, carry heavy equipment, and perform duties in adverse weather and outdoor conditions.
• Valid passport and driver’s license.
• Availability to work overtime and weekends and travel domestically and internationally as required.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

• Estimated current salary range: $24.03 per hour to an unspecified maximum amount.

Benefits & Perks:

• Medical insurance.
• Dental insurance.
• Vision insurance.
• Life insurance.
• Short-term and long-term disability insurance.
• 401(k) plan with employer match of up to 3%.

Equal Opportunity Statement: Our client is an equal opportunity employer. They celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Data Analyst III
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst III based in United States.

The Data Analyst III will apply advanced analytics to healthcare and human services data to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities for meaningful improvement.

You will work with complex datasets to identify variances, outliers, and statistically significant groups that can inform quality initiatives and investigations.

The role combines statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, data preparation, and sophisticated visualization.

You will collaborate with analysts and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights.

Your work will help evaluate interventions, measure outcomes, and support data-driven decisions across critical healthcare programs.

You will also contribute to stronger data governance, analytical processes, and emerging capabilities across the organization.

This is an opportunity for an experienced analyst to take ownership of complex projects while working with modern analytical tools and meaningful real-world data.

Accountabilities

Prepare, clean, validate, and transform data from multiple sources to support advanced analytical initiatives.
Conduct complex statistical analyses to identify meaningful trends, patterns, variances, outliers, and percentile-ranked groups.
Apply statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and machine learning techniques to generate actionable insights and support decision-making.
Develop and implement predictive models to forecast trends and enable proactive planning.
Design and implement statistically sound sampling methodologies for analytical and investigative activities.
Develop code to join and manipulate multiple relational database tables required for complex analyses.
Create sophisticated charts, dashboards, and graphical presentations that communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Develop comprehensive analytical reports that provide actionable recommendations for strategic and operational decisions.
Collaborate with data analysts, business teams, and other departments to understand requirements and align analytical work with organizational objectives.
Contribute to the design of re-measurement strategies that assess interventions and quantify their impact on healthcare quality and outcomes.
Ensure analytical activities follow data governance standards and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve analytical processes, methodologies, and workflows while evaluating emerging technologies and approaches.
Plan and organize assigned work independently while working with management to prioritize projects and deliverables.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline is required, with equivalent professional experience potentially considered in lieu of formal education.
2–4 years of relevant professional experience required, with 5–7 years preferred.
Demonstrated experience performing advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, or related analytical work.
Strong proficiency with data analysis and programming tools such as SAS, SQL, Excel, R, Python, Tableau, or comparable technologies.
Experience preparing, cleaning, transforming, and analyzing complex datasets.
Strong SQL and relational database skills, including the ability to join and manipulate data across multiple tables.
Experience developing predictive models and applying machine learning algorithms to real-world analytical problems.
Strong understanding of statistical methodologies, sampling techniques, and analytical best practices.
Ability to create clear and sophisticated data visualizations that make complex findings accessible to diverse audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on identifying actionable insights rather than simply reporting data.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to collaborate effectively across teams while independently managing priorities and analytical deliverables.
Strong attention to data accuracy, integrity, security, and compliance.
Base SAS certification is preferred.

Benefits

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
Opportunity to work on meaningful healthcare and human services analytics initiatives.
Exposure to advanced statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, and data visualization.
Opportunity to work with tools including SAS, SQL, Excel, R, Python, and Tableau.
Collaborative, cross-functional working environment.
High degree of ownership over analytical projects and priorities.
Opportunity to contribute to process improvements and the continued advancement of data analytics capabilities.
Equal employment opportunity workplace committed to fair and inclusive employment practices.
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre-employment background and drug screening.

jobs.description:

The Senior Data Analyst will turn complex healthcare claims and eligibility data into actionable insights that support better business decisions.

This role focuses on identifying payment anomalies, uncovering trends, and improving the visibility and quality of healthcare data.

You will combine strong analytical capabilities with healthcare domain expertise to develop meaningful dashboards, reports, and recommendations.

Working closely with account management, clinical, and operational teams, you will translate business questions into effective analytical solutions.

The role also offers an opportunity to improve reporting efficiency through automation, streamlined workflows, and well-documented analytical processes.

Success in this position requires strong SQL expertise, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate sophisticated findings to non-technical audiences.

This is a fully remote opportunity open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States.

Accountabilities

Develop a strong understanding of organizational priorities and deliver analytical solutions that generate actionable recommendations and measurable business value.
Collect, clean, query, and analyze healthcare claims and eligibility data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities.
Conduct end-to-end ad-hoc analyses, including scoping requests, extracting relevant data, validating results, and presenting accurate findings to stakeholders.
Monitor data integrity through regular audits and quality checks, ensuring datasets are accurate, complete, and reliable.
Develop and maintain dashboards using claims and eligibility data to provide internal teams with clear insights for client discussions and business decisions.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand their goals, challenges, and reporting needs and translate them into effective analytical deliverables.
Prepare on-demand analyses and reports that clearly communicate key findings, trends, and recommendations.
Present analytical results in clear, concise language and translate complex data findings into practical recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring analytical and reporting processes, streamline workflows, and reduce manual effort.
Collaborate with internal teams to implement automation initiatives that improve reporting efficiency and consistency.
Document analytical methodologies, data workflows, and processes to promote transparency, repeatability, and knowledge sharing.
Build strong working relationships with account managers, clinical teams, and operational partners by understanding their needs and providing reliable analytical support.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, mathematics, or a related discipline; alternatively, 7+ years of directly relevant healthcare claims analytics experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
Minimum 5 years of professional analytical experience working with healthcare claims data.
At least 5 years of strong SQL experience, including data querying, extraction, validation, and analysis.
Solid understanding of healthcare claims and eligibility data structures, including ICD, CPT, DRG, and related coding conventions.
Experience analyzing complex datasets and translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations within a business environment.
Familiarity with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or QlikView.
Familiarity with Python for data manipulation, reporting automation, or workflow improvement is a plus.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with a high level of attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to independently manage and prioritize multiple ad-hoc analytical requests while maintaining quality and meeting stakeholder deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to organizational goals and practical decisions.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and build productive relationships with business, clinical, account management, and operational stakeholders.
Willingness to stay current with evolving analytics tools, methodologies, and healthcare data practices and apply new approaches when they provide value.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Fully remote work opportunity within the United States.
Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with account management, clinical, and operational teams.
Opportunities to improve analytical workflows through automation and process optimization.
